author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Previews Twitch raid destinations and delays shutdown through the raid countdown and any running ending ad.
changelog: 4.1.121: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.121, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 4.0.32: waits for a running ad before sending the raid so the raid countdown ends after the ad, while the target card and clips stay on screen. 2.4.0: added a bounded stream-scoped viewer suggestion queue backed by a specific Twitch Channel Points reward, transactional fulfill/refund handling, one-suggestion-per-viewer protection, and automatic offline/next-stream clearing; also aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 1.0.0: initial release with configurable discovery order, bounded Twitch searches, preferred-channel batching, viewer/language/category/tag filters, similar-size preference, stream-based recent-raid protection, shuffle-without-repeats, expiring suggestions, creator Confirm/Cancel actions, optional advanced automatic mode, editable chat output, and a styled Next Stop overlay card.

manifest.name: Raid Scout
installationSteps: Import the separate Raid Scout Streamer.bot package.
Keep its Controller action triggerless and approve that action ID as Raid Scout's fixed controller grant.

Attach Finish Stream, Suggest, Confirm, and Cancel only to creator-controlled hotkeys, deck buttons, or operator commands. Finish Stream is the streamlined one-press path through every enabled ending step.

SprigCast only: For optional automatic broadcast ending, keep Run Ending Ad triggerless and attach Ad Break Companion's Ad Run Intake to Twitch Ads > Ad Run. Leave the ending app on Same as my streaming app: StreamBridge ends the stream in SprigCast itself, so no Stop Streaming action is needed.

OBS, Meld or Streamlabs only: For optional automatic broadcast ending, keep Run Ending Ad triggerless and attach Ad Break Companion's Ad Run Intake to Twitch Ads > Ad Run. Choose OBS Studio, Meld Studio, or Streamlabs Desktop in the wizard, select and approve that provider's Stop Streaming action, and attach Broadcast Stopped only to the selected provider's Streaming Stopped trigger.
Optionally configure a Streamer.bot-owned Twitch reward ID for stream-scoped viewer suggestions.
Configure preferred channels and filters, then test Suggest before enabling automatic mode.

OBS only: In OBS, leave Browser Source hardware acceleration enabled and turn off Shutdown source when not visible for the Raid Scout source so its cached clip renderer is already warm when the raid preview begins.
SprigCast only: In SprigCast, turn on Keep running when hidden for the Raid Scout source so its cached clip renderer is already warm when the raid preview begins.
Meld only: In Meld, keep the Raid Scout browser layer in its scene so its cached clip renderer is already warm when the raid preview begins.
Streamlabs only: In Streamlabs, turn off Shutdown source when not visible for the Raid Scout source so its cached clip renderer is already warm when the raid preview begins.

Use the Raid Scout overlay URL exactly as the wizard shows it (http://localhost:<port>/overlay/addons/thsv.raid-scout). Raid targets' clips play in Twitch's embedded clip player, which refuses 127.0.0.1; a source still set to 127.0.0.1 reopens itself on localhost automatically.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its private suggestion and raid history is kept for a later reinstall.

healthChecks.description: Checks that channel search, filters, no-repeat picks, and raids you confirm on Twitch all work.
